# SolveitCDP API


<!-- WARNING: THIS FILE WAS AUTOGENERATED! DO NOT EDIT! -->

``` python
import threading
from fastcore.test import test_eq, expect_fail
```

[`Channel`](https://AnswerDotAI.github.io/solvecdp/core.html#channel)
connects to rustygate’s `/api/wsx` relay for ongoing JSON messaging. Set
`JUPYGATE_URL` to the gateway’s URL, or pass a full WebSocket `url` to
[`Channel.connect`](https://AnswerDotAI.github.io/solvecdp/core.html#channel.connect).
The default gateway is `http://127.0.0.1:8787`.

Rustygate supplies `JUPYGATE_URL` to every spawned kernel and trusts
loopback connections; pass `token=` to send
`Authorization: Bearer <token>` against a token-gated gateway. Peers
join the same named channel even when the kernel connects directly over
loopback and the browser or desktop app connects through Solveit’s
`/rusty/api/wsx` proxy.

### Channel

``` python
def Channel(
    chan, url:NoneType=None
):
```

*Duplex JSON messaging with the other peers on a named `/api/wsx` relay
channel*

Connect each peer to the same channel name on rustygate’s `/api/wsx`
relay. The relay forwards each frame unchanged to every other peer on
that channel. `solvecdp` uses
[`Channel`](https://AnswerDotAI.github.io/solvecdp/core.html#channel) to
communicate with the
[solveit-chrome](https://github.com/AnswerDotAI/solveit-chrome)
extension.

[`Channel`](https://AnswerDotAI.github.io/solvecdp/core.html#channel)
sends JSON dictionaries. Pass the fields as keyword arguments to `send`.
Incoming frames become `AttrDict` objects. If a frame’s `id` matches a
pending request, it completes that request. Other frames go into the
`events` queue.

Here we connect two peers and send a greeting. The second peer reads it
from `events`.

``` python
ch1,ch2 = await Channel.connect('test'),await Channel.connect('test')
await ch1.send(hello='world')
test_eq((await ch2.events.get()).hello, 'world')
```

`request` adds a unique `id` and waits for a reply with that `id`.
Requests can run concurrently. The peer answering a request must include
its `id` in the reply. This example replies with twice the supplied
number.

``` python
async def _responder():
    msg = await ch2.events.get()
    await ch2.send(id=msg.id, result=msg.x*2)

task = asyncio.create_task(_responder())
test_eq((await ch1.request(x=21)).result, 42)
```

Check `is_open` before and after closing the connections.

``` python
assert ch1.is_open
await ch1.close()
await ch2.close()
assert not ch1.is_open
```

### JsCDP

``` python
def JsCDP(
    wsconn:str=None, # WebSocket URL, populated by connection helpers
    debug:bool=False, # Log protocol events
    command_timeout:float=10, # Seconds before an unanswered command raises TimeoutError
):
```

*CDP over the solveit-chrome extension: frames relayed via rustygate’s
`/api/wsx` channel*

Everything else comes from `fastcdp.ext`’s `ExtCDP`: the
`sessionId`↔`tabId` mapping, the lifecycle actions, and
`new_page`/`attach_page`/`pages`.
[`JsCDP`](https://AnswerDotAI.github.io/solvecdp/core.html#jscdp) just
supplies the channel, meeting the extension at rustygate’s `/api/wsx`
relay instead of listening on a local port (a solveit kernel usually
runs in a container that the user’s browser can’t reach, so both sides
dial out to the relay).

Connect, open a tab, and drive it. `goto`, `eval`, and friends are all
inherited from fastcdp through the `Page` proxy:

``` python
cdp = await JsCDP.connect()
page = await cdp.new_page()
await page.goto('https://httpbingo.org/forms/post')
await page.eval('document.title')
```

``` python
assert 'httpbingo.org' in await page.eval('document.title')
assert first(await cdp.pages, lambda t: 'httpbingo' in t.get('url',''))
```

The accessibility tree and form helpers also come straight from fastcdp:
find elements with `ax_tree`/`find_id`, then `fill_text`, `click`,
`select_option`, and `click_and_wait`.

``` python
root = await page.ax_tree()
await page.fill_text(root.find_id('textbox', 'Customer name'), 'Jeremy Howard')
await page.click(root.find_id('radio', 'Large'))
await page.click(root.find_id('checkbox', 'Extra Cheese'))
```

``` python
await page.click_and_wait(root.find_id('button', 'Submit order'))
assert 'Jeremy Howard' in await page.eval('document.body.innerText')
```

The debugging buffers work too, since every `chrome.debugger` event is
streamed over the channel and dispatched by the inherited machinery:

``` python
await page.start_console()
await page.eval(r'console.warn("watch out")')
test_eq(await page.console(r'watch'), ['warning: watch out'])
```

``` python
await page.close()
await cdp.close()
```

## Running AppleScript with solvebridge

Because `/api/wsx` stores no messages and drops frames when no peer is
connected,
[`_wait_bridge`](https://AnswerDotAI.github.io/solvecdp/core.html#_wait_bridge)
waits until a `solvebridge` peer either replies `ok: true` to a `ping`
probe or announces `{"event": "hello"}` on connect before sending an
AppleScript command.

[`aosa`](https://AnswerDotAI.github.io/solvecdp/core.html#aosa) opens a
[`Channel`](https://AnswerDotAI.github.io/solvecdp/core.html#channel)
(default `chan='mac'`), waits for `solvebridge` via
[`_wait_bridge`](https://AnswerDotAI.github.io/solvecdp/core.html#_wait_bridge),
and sends one `osascript` command. Replies carrying an `error` field
(such as a user denial or unsupported platform) or a nonzero
`returncode` raise `RuntimeError`.

### aosa

``` python
async def aosa(
    script:str, # AppleScript source to run on the connected Mac
    chan:str='mac', # Relay channel name `solvebridge` connects to
    url:str=None, # Full relay URL (defaults to `/api/wsx` on `JUPYGATE_URL`)
    token:str=None, # Optional bearer token for token-gated gateways
    timeout:float=60, # Seconds to wait for approval and execution
    wait_connect:float=25, # Seconds to wait for `solvebridge` to answer `ping` or `hello`
    ping_interval:float=1.5, # Seconds between `ping` probes while waiting for `solvebridge`
)->str:
```

*Run AppleScript `script` on the user’s Mac through `solvebridge` and
return stdout*

Test the full handshake and error paths against a fake bridge peer on
`/api/wsx`: late-connecting `hello` wakeup, `ping` replies, user
denials, nonzero exit codes, disconnected timeouts, and calling
synchronous
[`osa`](https://AnswerDotAI.github.io/solvecdp/core.html#osa) while an
event loop is already running.

``` python
async def _fake_bridge(chan, delay=0, limit=None):
    if delay: await asyncio.sleep(delay)
    ch = await Channel.connect(chan)
    try:
        await ch.send(event='hello', platform='macos', app='solvebridge')
        seen = 0
        while limit is None or seen < limit:
            msg = await ch.events.get()
            if msg.get('cmd') == 'ping': await ch.send(id=msg.id, ok=True, platform='macos')
            elif msg.get('cmd') == 'osascript':
                seen += 1
                s = msg.script
                if s == 'deny': await ch.send(id=msg.id, error='denied by user')
                elif s == 'fail': await ch.send(id=msg.id, stdout='', stderr='syntax error', returncode=1)
                else: await ch.send(id=msg.id, stdout=f'ran: {s}\n', stderr='', returncode=0)
    finally: await ch.close()
```

``` python
bridge = asyncio.create_task(_fake_bridge('test-mac', delay=0.08, limit=3))
test_eq(await aosa('activate', chan='test-mac', ping_interval=0.05), 'ran: activate\n')
with expect_fail(RuntimeError, 'denied by user'): await aosa('deny', chan='test-mac', ping_interval=0.05)
with expect_fail(RuntimeError, 'syntax error'): await aosa('fail', chan='test-mac', ping_interval=0.05)
await bridge
with expect_fail(TimeoutError, 'not connected'): await aosa('noop', chan='test-mac-empty', wait_connect=0.15, ping_interval=0.05)
```

[`osa`](https://AnswerDotAI.github.io/solvecdp/core.html#osa) wraps
[`aosa`](https://AnswerDotAI.github.io/solvecdp/core.html#aosa)
synchronously so Solveit’s `py` tool can run AppleScript without
`await`, even inside a Jupyter kernel where an asyncio event loop is
already running.

### osa

``` python
def osa(
    script:str, # AppleScript source to run on the connected Mac
    *, chan:str='mac', # Relay channel name `solvebridge` connects to
    url:str=None, # Full relay URL (defaults to `/api/wsx` on `JUPYGATE_URL`)
    token:str=None, # Optional bearer token for token-gated gateways
    timeout:float=60, # Seconds to wait for approval and execution
    wait_connect:float=25, # Seconds to wait for `solvebridge` to answer `ping` or `hello`
    ping_interval:float=1.5, # Seconds between `ping` probes while waiting for `solvebridge`
)->str:
```

*Run AppleScript `script` synchronously on the user’s Mac through
`solvebridge` and return stdout*

``` python
t = threading.Thread(target=asyncio.run, args=(_fake_bridge('test-mac-sync', delay=0.05, limit=1),))
t.start()
test_eq(osa('tell Word', chan='test-mac-sync', ping_interval=0.05), 'ran: tell Word\n')
t.join(2)
assert not t.is_alive()
```
